description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'HomeController' that handles HTTP GET requests for the root URL ('/'). It retrieves user-specific notifications and contracts, adds them to the model, and returns the view 'index' to render the home page for logged-in users.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that handles rendering the home page with user-specific notifications and contracts.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/', retrieves current user info, notifications, and contracts, and returns the 'index' view.
